description: This file defines the ViewConfig class for the EmailMan module in SuiteCRM, responsible for rendering the configuration settings page for email management, including email server settings, notifications, and security options.

classes.name: ViewConfig
classes.description: A class extending SugarView that manages the display of email configuration settings in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Returns the module title parameters as an array of HTML links and labels for the admin interface.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Checks user permissions before allowing access to the configuration page.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the email configuration settings page, assembling various settings and options into templates.
